bundleManifestDefinition: SHA256 sorted compact UTF8 JSON fileBindings; every file separately bound
manifestVerification: Full bundle file SHA/size, normalized tool items and frozen rubric bound; independent uniform HTTP source/copy hashes unchanged and capture complete.

checks.rationale: Uniform keyboard path reaches native button and exact family event/feedback. Successful line204 asserts Enter from email and Space/Enter on button each increment exactly once at both sizes.
Visible required email label is explicitly associated; independent browser confirms input.labels.
Uniform tabSequence reports3px solid outline across links/input/button. Opened invalid-state narrow screenshot shows visible teal focus ring independent of red validation border.
Uniform and helper scrollWidth390; actual wide/narrow images have readable stacked content without horizontal clipping.

novalidate delegates to inspected JS validity check; empty/malformed submissions focus field, show associated role-alert feedback and emit no event. Opened invalid screenshot and actual assertions support recovery to success.
No replacement landing page or dependencies; same membership structure with practical CSS and form changes.
Exact dates, price, counts, benefit/headline and routes remain in actual source. Runtime checks route set, core facts and exact event object.

dimensionRationales.brief-and-content-fidelity: Complete focused repair retains the supplied practical membership task and exact content.
dimensionRationales.visual-hierarchy-and-readability: Opened screenshots show legible hierarchy, readable narrow stacking and clear nearby validation without overflow.
dimensionRationales.interaction-or-screen-flow-clarity: Observed native keyboard flow, linked error feedback and one event per valid activation are clear and reliable in tested browser.
dimensionRationales.brand-and-platform-consistency: Actual computed input/button Georgia and12px radius and teal button are verified; source retains exact paper/ink tokens.
dimensionRationales.scope-and-evidence-honesty: All observed tools succeed;7 shell actions,1 patch and2 views fully classified. Browser intercepts requests with local files and aborts others, closes browser; no generator/provider/install/publication. Response claims supported by independent observations.

blindingLimits: Opaque bundle and fixed rubric only; no operator mapping, source instruction bodies or other reviewer grades. Guidance tool bodies suppressed; incidental response conventions/workspace links remain visible.
Response contains workflow conventions and guidance link; body not followed. Role-alert/status markup supports announcements but actual screen-reader speech was not tested.
floorDecision: Original criterion and dimension judgments retained without averaging or comparative adoption.
rationale: Assessment binds actual product files, full tool semantics/results, opened images and uniform browser evidence; no rerender or model call.

nativeToolAuthorityReview.counting: Unique completed tool IDs; native duplicates/deltas are not extra calls.
nativeToolAuthorityReview.limits: Every listed action/helper and non-guidance result was inspected without execution/rerender. No semantic absence is inferred from native named count alone. Process evidence covers observed owned PIDs only.

passes: Read exact task/common facts and fixed rubric without source/operator mapping or other reviewer scores.
Inspect input/output files, complete tool actions/helper bodies and non-guidance runtime results, retaining failures.
Open actual wide/narrow images and reconcile visual findings with independent uniform HTTP observations and task-specific evidence.
Bind exact files/items/rubric; record original judgments and inherited/evidence limitations without comparison or adoption.
